open_findings.summary: The report describes the forecast as accepted without support in the provided artifacts.
open_findings.required_evidence: Remove “accepted” or provide an artifact that establishes the forecast’s acceptance status.

advisory_findings.summary: The note includes process metadata in its header.
advisory_findings.required_evidence: A note without process or control metadata.

advisory_findings.summary: The cutoff date in the report header lacks an evidence key.
advisory_findings.required_evidence: Add an evidence key for the cutoff date or remove the unanchored date.

unchanged_criteria.acceptance: all numerical gates pass; 2 consecutive full reviews of the same candidate with no blocking finding open; human approval. Minor findings are advisory and do not block.

delta_scope: partial re-build from the writer stage (earliest stage owned by an open finding); earlier stages are carried forward unchanged under a fresh request binding; the deterministic engines re-run with the model stage; carried findings must be addressed
